name: spawn_point
title: room.spawn_point
lead: The room's number. Rooms also compare by identity with `==`. Where players arrive in this room; writable. A write is not stored and does not move the chunks that stay loaded.

usedIn.quote: room.spawn_point = vec3(0.5, 80, 0.5)     -- the same field of a different room
- A write to `world.spawn_point` or `room.spawn_point` changes where a player
